key.name: showsongtooltip
key.description: If true, shows the song, artist, station info when hovered over the radio icon

key.name: shownewtracknotification
key.summary: Show a desktop notification on track change
key.description: If true, pops up a desktop notification with the artist and title whenever the station reports a new track.

key.name: rightclicksettings
key.summary: Opens the settings on right click
key.description: If true, opens the settings window when right clicked on the radio icon.

key.name: rightclickcopysong
key.summary: Copy the song title on right click
key.description: If true, copies the song title into clipboard when right clicked on the radio icon.

key.name: gnomesearch
key.description: If true, can search for saved stations and play them using Gnome search.

key.name: prefswindowwidth
key.description: Remembers the last size the preferences window was resized to.

key.name: prefswindowheight
key.description: Remembers the last size the preferences window was resized to.

key.name: syncfolder
key.description: A local folder (or an already-mounted WebDAV/cloud location) that stations and settings are synced through.

key.name: synclastat
key.description: ISO timestamp of the last successful push or pull, for display only.

key.name: synclastremotemtime
key.summary: Remote bundle mtime at last sync
key.description: Used internally to detect whether the sync folder changed since we last looked.

key.name: synclastlocalmtime
key.summary: Local channels.json mtime at last sync
key.description: Used internally to detect whether the local station list changed since we last looked.

key.name: enrichtrackdata
key.description: If true, looks up cover art for the current radio track via MusicBrainz and the Cover Art Archive.

key.name: chromecastenabled
key.summary: Enable casting to Chromecast/Google TV devices
key.description: If true, shows a "Cast to..." option to stream the current radio station or podcast episode to a Chromecast or Google TV device. Requires python3-pychromecast to be installed.
